title: Band on the Map Area Config
description: Canonical, city-agnostic contract for one managed discovery Area (see docs/VENUE_DISCOVERY.md). An Area tells the venue discovery engine (ingestion/venue-discovery/) where and how to look for candidate live-music venues. One file per area under areas/<area_id>.json — never a Venue, Source, or Candidate registry itself.

area_id.description: Stable application identity for this Area, independent of any one source or collector. Never reused for a different real-world area.

metro_name.description: Optional wider metro/area name, where the managed radius extends meaningfully beyond the named city itself.

centre.description: A sensible centre coordinate from an authoritative or widely-accepted geographic reference. Not required to be a precise geometric centroid.

radius_km.description: Configurable discovery radius around centre. Never hardcoded by the engine itself — this is the one place it is set, per area.

languages.description: Local language codes relevant to discovery vocabulary and evidence text in this area.

discovery_keywords.description: Non-exhaustive, non-frozen local-language discovery vocabulary keyed by language code, e.g. { "ca": ["sala de concerts"], "es": ["musica en vivo"], "en": ["live music"] }. Used for human research and future keyword-based sources — never treated as a complete ontology.

discovery_sources.description: Which discovery collector(s) run for this area, and their per-area configuration. Each entry's source_kind selects a collector family (see ingestion/venue-discovery/); fields beyond source_kind are collector-specific and not constrained here.
